title: Footer and FAQ: Chatticus is in beta (not live in production)
description:
## Problem
Footer status line says \"Chatticus · Live in production\". FAQ answers \"Is Chatticus ready for general use?\" with \"Yes\" and \"live in production today\", while `/beta` says features change without notice and there is no uptime guarantee. Launch messaging must be honest: we are in **beta**.

## Decisions (locked)
1. Change footer status line in `web/components/Footer.tsx` from `Chatticus · Live in production` to exactly: `Chatticus · Beta`.
2. Rewrite the FAQ item \"Is Chatticus ready for general use?\" in `web/components/Faq.tsx` so the answer is **no, not general availability** — Chatticus is in **public beta**. Keep the useful technical truth (conversation foundation and computer handoff paths exist) but frame it as beta, expanding skills/routines/approvals UI/computer preview, and no GA uptime promise.
3. Search marketing `web/` copy for other \"live in production\" / \"general availability\" / \"ready for general use\" claims that conflict with beta and align them. Do not weaken `/beta` honesty copy.
4. Do not change product runtime behavior — marketing copy only.

## Done when
- Footer says Beta
- FAQ no longer claims general-use readiness / unqualified production
- No remaining conflicting \"LIVE IN PRODUCTION\" marketing claims on the homepage chrome
- Touched tests updated if any assert old strings
